$comment: Carrier registry, seeded from the recording. `id` is the EZLynx carrier id that
appears in toggle selectors (#carrier-{id}-{slug}-button) and in carrier-question
selector suffixes (__{id}). Regenerate/extend with scripts/build-flow-map.ts output.
Selection strategy is select-all-then-prune (PLAN.md 7a): everything is selected,
then the recovery loop drops carriers that fail validation, each with a reason.
Use allow/deny in defaults.json to curate without touching code.
